summary: Simple signals (Initiative 4). Scaffolded manually 2026-09-30; intent in progress. Artifacts in Vietnamese.

entries.author: Thach
entries.text: Owner (own need): bot only shows price, not trend; signals used to decide buy/sell. Out of scope: paid tiers, non-Zalo channels, coins outside the watchlist.

entries.author: Thach
entries.text: Answers 2026-09-30: may give buy/sell advice as reference; trend = strong swings over a few days; shown in morning digest AND proactive alert on strong move; watchlist coins only; backtest wanted. Threshold, disclaimer, alert frequency left to spec.

entries.author: Thach
entries.text: Proactive alert max once per hour on strong swing. Owner wants price history stored to evaluate past recommendations (how = spec).

entries.author: Thach
entries.text: Spec draft: swing = >=8%/24h or >=15%/72h; advice by position in 7d range (bottom25% buy, top25% sell, else watch); max 1 signal msg/hour/chat, no repeat 24h per coin unless +5pp; default-on with /tinhieu tat; backtest 90d + live scorecard, 3-day hit criterion. Storage of price history deferred to plan (free-tier limits).

entries.author: Thach
entries.text: Plan draft: all signals data in Upstash Redis (not Neon) to keep Neon asleep; new /cron/signals every 30min via cron-job.org; watchlist mirrored to Redis (write-through + daily resync in digest); history backfill via CoinGecko market_chart (UNVERIFIED, verify in step 2); scorecard/backtest computed on read; watcher extended for signals health.

entries.author: Claude
entries.text: Verified CoinGecko market_chart days=90 keyless: HTTP 200, 2161 hourly points, ~223KB/coin. Rate limit for backfill of 5 coins still unmeasured (implement step 2). plan.md updated; awaiting human review.
